The '''Loratus system''' was located in the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the company [[Loratus Manufacturing]].<ref name="CSWE LoratusManufacturing">{{CSWECite|II|261|Loratus Manufacturing}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Loratus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-17.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
